skills.name: Composite - Fasten an object with power tool
skills.description: Use a power tool to fasten an object to a surface using fixing hardware. Assumes that the object has been positioned on the surface.

steps.activity: Position the fixing_hardware on the object_to_fasten
Position the power_tool at the fixing_hardware
Pull the trigger of the power_tool
Push the fixing_hardware through the object_to_fasten and into the fastening_surface using the power_tool
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Fasten a wing wham to wall studs with screws and an power screwdriver
Fasten roof flashing to a wall with screws and an power screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Loosen an object with a power tool
skills.description: Use a power tool to loosen an object from a surface

steps.activity: Position the power_tool at the fixing_hardware
Pull the trigger of the power_tool
Pull the fixing_hardware out of the fastening_surface and through the object_to_loosen using the power_tool
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Remove the screws from an electrical panel cover with a power screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Fasten an object with a handheld screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver by hand to fasten an object to a surface.

steps.activity: Position the screwdriver at the screw on the object_to_fasten
Rotate screwdriver to drive the screw into the fastening_surface
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Push the screwdriver to driver the screw forward
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Tighten a hose clamp on a pipe with a screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Loosen an object with a handheld screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver by hand to loosen an object from a surface.

steps.activity: Position the screwdriver at the screw on the object_to_loosen
Rotate screwdriver to loosen the screw from the fastening_surface
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Pull the screwdriver to pull the screw out of the fastening_surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Loosen a terminal screw with a handheld screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Fasten an electrical wire to a terminal with a screwdriver
skills.description: Position a wire in a terminal and rotate a screwdriver to fasten the wire to the terminal.

steps.activity: Position the wire_to_fasten in the terminal
Rotate the screwdriver to tighten the terminal screw and fasten the wire_to_fasten to the terminal
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

examples: Fasten a wire to a circuit breaker terminal with a screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Disconnect wire by loosening terminal screw with a screwdriver
skills.description: Rotate a screwdriver to loosen a terminal screw and remove the wire from the terminal.

steps.activity: Rotate the screwdriver to loosen the terminal screw holding the wire in the terminal
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Pull the wire out of the terminal
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Loosen a wire from a circuit breaker terminal with a screwdriver

skills.name: Composite - Attach a tape to a surface
skills.description: Position and secure an adhesive tape over a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the extent of the surface where the tape will be applied
Position the beginning of the tape at one side of the determined extent of the surface
Pull the tape across the surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Press the tape on the surface to secure it

examples: Attach a tape along a horizontal line on a wall before painting

skills.name: Composite - Tape an object to a surface
skills.description: Position and fix an object to a surface with a tape.

steps.activity: Determine the fixing position on the surface
Position the object_to_fasten tape at the fixing position on the surface
Attach the tape to the object_to_fasten
steps.category: Composite - Attach a tape to a surface

steps.activity: Pull the tape to extend it across the surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Press the tape on the surface to secure it

examples: Use a tape to fasten an stencil to a wall before painting

skills.name: Composite - Attach an object with adhesive to a surface
skills.description: Position and secure an object with adhesive over a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the extent of the surface where the object_to_attach will be attached
Position the object_to_attach at the determined location on the surface
Press the object_to_attach on the surface to secure it

examples: Attach a wall panel with adhesive on it to a wall

skills.name: Composite - Attach masking material with tape dispenser
skills.description: Use a tape dispenser to position and secure a masking material and  tape over a surface or component.

steps.activity: Determine the extent of the surface_to_protect
Position the tape dispenser on one side of the surface_to_protect
Press the masking_tape along the masking_material edges
Unroll the tape dispenser across the surface_to_protect
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Pull the tape dispenser to cut the film and tape with the blade
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Attach masking film to a window edge with tape dispenser

skills.name: Composite - Remove a taped object from a surface
skills.description: Remove an object that has been taped to a surface.

steps.activity: Peel tape from the object_to_remove and/or surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with fingers

steps.activity: Grab the object_to_remove
Pull the object_to_remove away from the surface to remove it
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Remove a taped stencil from a wall after painting
